BELIEF_STATE: UNDERSTANDING: Module responsibility: Convert discovered source files into deterministic StoredBlock records using parallel full-index processing for full and later incremental indexing. Key data flows: - INPUT: Walker IndexFile records, project root, parser CodeBlocks, and source file contents. - PROCESSING: Read bounded source files in parallel, parse code blocks, build StoredBlock values with empty embedding metadata, and normalize ordering. - OUTPUT: Stable StoredBlock vectors consumed by M-INDEXER, M-INDEXER-EMBEDDING, and M-INDEXER-STORAGE. Critical invariants: - StoredBlock IDs stay path:start_line compatible with existing search and GraphRAG logic. - Oversized or unreadable files are skipped without aborting the full index. - Ordering is deterministic before persistence. IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY: Approach: Extract pure StoredBlock construction from M-INDEXER first, then layer parallel and delta behavior in later Phase-64 steps. Complexity_areas: preserving existing indexing semantics, deterministic ordering, bounded file reads. Patterns_applied: source-backed module contract, explicit pipeline functions, local unit tests. VERIFICATION_INTENT: I expect the following to be true after implementation: - Pipeline unit tests cover metadata preservation, deterministic ordering, and large-file skipping. - M-INDEXER search behavior remains compatible through the existing public index_directory API. RISKS_ACKNOWLEDGED: - Ordering changes can affect persisted snapshots if not normalized consistently. - Parallel execution must reuse the same deterministic output boundary.
